beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. There was a small change; I'll explain how small once you're ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How small a change?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. The date is the smallest part. Let's finish tea before the venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the gentler account from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. When I said postponed, I meant the original event won't return unchanged.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What does unchanged mean?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. The invitation still has our names. That's the part we can hold onto first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the half admission from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. I changed the time; yours is the only missing piece of the story now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why tell me only half?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. Because the second half is sitting in your envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the small confession from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. I hid the first letter. What happened to the second?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So you hid the letter?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. The first. I'm offering that truth so you can place yours beside it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the failed result from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. That strange noise was the turning point, not a warning I missed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You ignored the strange noise.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. I treated it as foreshadowing. Now its significance is wonderfully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the old sketch from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. The ending was foreshadowed here; the plan needed this reversal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The plan collapsed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. Exactly at the point this drawing becomes interesting.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the vague prediction from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. When I said 'a change', I obviously meant this precise disaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a flood.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. I said things would flow differently. Read with professional imagination.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the wrong forecast from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Read it metaphorically and you'll see I was right.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says sunny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. An emotional forecast. The umbrellas represent personal growth.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the renamed score column from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Fewest points means greatest self-control; I've won that category.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You came last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. In speed. First in refusing to rush the experience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the tiny trophy from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Size measures insecurity now, so this is the better prize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the consolation prize.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. For whoever needs a large trophy. I'm delighted with my superior restraint.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the hopeful drawing from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. We wanted a place to belong; even this wreck can become that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The place is wrecked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. But we drew somewhere for us, not somewhere already perfect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the first promise on paper from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. We're still making that hope real, just in a larger shape.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before everything failed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. Then let's make the promise large enough to include the wreckage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the wrapped cup from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Take this for whenever you remember these afternoons.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you giving me this?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. So you won't have to come back just to remember tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the straightened coat from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. You'll do beautifully wherever the next door opens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That sounds like goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. Only the sort that hopes your next doorway fits you better.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the two prices from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. The lift costs petrol and the conversation we've been avoiding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay for petrol.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. And we'll talk during the drive. That's the part I couldn't put on the receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the bill and photograph from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Pay for the repair in money, and for the silence in honesty.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why charge for silence?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. Because money repairs the chair. Honesty repairs why I broke it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the quoted agreement from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. I promised to carry a box, not whichever box you point at forever.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You promised to help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. With a box. That was before you gave the warehouse a name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the underlined today from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Yes, I said today; tomorrow wasn't included in those words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow is practically the same.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. Not to the sentence we both agreed to yesterday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the cup, note, and key from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Every little choice has brought us to this locked door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How are those connected?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. The cup hid the note, the note asked for the key, and now neither of us can leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.action: I present the napkin with our returning joke from the bag I already packed for you.
beats.text: I've prepared for that choice. Remember saying nothing could go wrong? Look at what we're carrying now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was only a joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. And now you're holding its three separate consequences. Which one do we solve first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I might choose something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.
